acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the climate in the Boise area, including Garden City and Meridian, can present specific challenges for door leak repair. Our seasonal temperature fluctuations, from hot summers to freezing winters, can cause materials to expand and contract, potentially stressing sealants and weatherstripping over time. Additionally, periods of heavy rain or snowmelt can expose vulnerabilities in door installations. We account for these environmental factors by using flexible, durable materials designed to withstand these conditions and maintain a watertight seal.
